To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the decreasing saturation of the primary color RGB has an influence on the printed image quality.
the quality of printed color image decreases when the saturation of the primary color decreases.
the quality of printed color images decreases when the saturation of the primary color RGB is decreased.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the subjective assessment of the color-change of printed images.
the relation between color saturation of printed images and image quality.
the quantifying of the relation between the quality of printed image and the color change caused by the saturation of primary colors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the decreasing saturation of color has an effect on the quality of printed image, and that the effect of the decreasing saturation of primary colors on the image quality can be quantified.
the color-change of images due to the color-saturation of primary colors affects the subjective image quality of the images.
the decreasing color saturation of B affects the quality of the printed image more than that of R and G. Proc. SPIE 5293, Color Imaging: Device-Independent Color
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the quality of a printed color image is affected by the color change of the primary colors and the color change is not uniform.
the color-change of printed images caused by the saturation of primary colors can be quantified as the color-change of images in a color-management-system.
the quality of the printed image can be quantified by the color-change of image.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the color management system should consider the effect of color-change of the printed images on the image quality.
the color management system can be applied to the color image reproduction system.
we have shown a way to measure the effect of the saturation decrease on the image quality by using the subjective experiment.
